PH: local emission sources anchored to field nodes and impact locus

vfx.primary_shape: dual-plane digital field with front frame, rear frame, corner connectors, clear protected airspace
vfx.macro: tall chamfered field volume around receiver
vfx.meso: front and rear rails plus corner connectors
vfx.micro: node emitters, rail highlights, event-specific cut lines or impact locus

events.create: assembly sweep closes same field structure
events.absorb: same field dents inward at impact point while local source intensifies
events.fracture: same field tears diagonally and shears apart
events.bust: same field deauthorizes and splits outward, central links shut down

sfx.absorb: impact chirp with short noise ring
